Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray shows right lung volume loss with a kinked vessel, and the specific absence of the right upper lobe bronchus and vein points to a congenital developmental defect rather than acquired atelectasis or obstruction. This constellation of findings is most consistent with pulmonary hypoplasia (or agenesis) of the right upper lobe.
